Destroy an untracked managed resource after exact-ID confirmation

Usage: mj recover destroy [OPTIONS] --session <SESSION> --target <TARGET> --confirm <CONFIRM>

Options:
  -i, --instance <NAME>    Isolate configuration, database, daemon, and logs under `instances/<name>`. This is a different `mj` world, not a harness profile; explicit `MJ_CONFIG_DIR`/`MJ_DATA_DIR` still take precedence [env: MJ_INSTANCE=]
      --session <SESSION>  Session id of the worker, as `mj recover scan` lists it
      --no-splash          Start the dashboard without the animated startup splash, for example over a slow remote connection [env: MJ_NO_SPLASH=]
      --target <TARGET>    Target the worker runs on, as `mj recover scan` lists it
      --confirm <CONFIRM>  The session id again, to confirm the destruction
      --all-instances      Allow destroying a worker another instance created, or one with no instance stamp
  -h, --help               Print help
